title: Recent advances in first-row transition metal clusters for photocatalytic water splitting
claim: Peripheral ligand identity and flexibility can change the water-oxidation behavior of cobalt-oxo cubanes.
explanation: The review contrasts substituted pyridine ligands in isomorphic Co(III) cubanes with a Co(II) cubane bearing exchangeable aqua and acetate ligands; ligand electronics, water coordination, and ligand exchange are discussed as relevant to activity.
conditions: The substituted-pyridine series was evaluated for oxygen production under visible-light illumination.
caveats: The review does not establish one ligand-electronic trend applicable to all cobalt cubanes; the identity of the active catalytic species remains contested.
